build_identity_semantics: BuildFingerprint is frozen and echoed exactly when supplied. Empty means unstamped; any non-empty value is an unverified reproducibility label, not authorization, signature, provenance, attestation, or proof of worker identity.
compile_semantics: Borrow one complete immutable Document v2 object graph and caller PNG bindings only until Compile returns; capability-check and deep-freeze the document, compute its canonical hash in this assembly, strictly decode every enabled image binding, and publish one immutable concurrent Program only after all stages agree.
excluded_responsibilities: Video/APNG/audio decode, text/vector rasterization, filesystem or network resolution, authorization, signatures, trusted build identity, scheduling, persistence, publication and a public compatibility guarantee are outside this static PNG reference vertical slice.
failure_semantics: Any context, configuration, document, binding, resource, stage, profile, geometry or hash mismatch fails closed with no Program or a zero render result. Compositor diagnostics are retained and defensively copied.
receipt_semantics: Bind the complete source manifest, ordered compositor source receipts, raster receipt, output-color receipt and PNG receipt. Recompute accessible surface/frame/artifact hashes and cross-check geometry and semantic profiles before returning.
render_semantics: Evaluate one exact timeline time or composition frame, request only strict native static PNG surfaces, apply evaluator transform/crop/opacity/keyframes/dissolve and multitrack order in the deterministic CPU raster compositor, convert the complete target surface to straight-alpha sRGB RGBA8, then encode the deterministic strict PNG profile.
